chunks: 963 - Zurarah said: I heard Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام say:
"Supplication after the obligatory prayer is better than performing prayer voluntarily."

key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: more virtuous or superior in merit
key_terms.بَعْدَ: after, indicating the time following an act

ai.seo_question: Is supplication after the obligatory prayer better than voluntary prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the excellence of du'a after the obligatory salat. It indicates that post-prayer supplication holds a special rank, even above performing an additional voluntary prayer at that moment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.963 - Zurarah reported that he heard Abu Ja'far (as) say:

"Supplication after the obligatory prayer is better than offering a voluntary prayer."
And thus, this has been the practice.
